title: 張一鳴（ByteDance創業者）
award: 2019（タイム誌 世界で最も影響力のある100人）
note: TIME100選出歴を確認：2019年版に選出（確認できたのは2019年のみ）。2026年1月に米TikTokは合弁会社へ移管（ByteDance持分20%未満）、2026年9月にブルームバーグ富豪指数でアジア首位と報道。
sources: TIME「Zhang Yiming: The 100 Most Influential People of 2019」、Wikipedia「Zhang Yiming」、Caixin Global「ByteDance CEO Steps Down: Zhang Yiming's Full Letter to Staff」、TechNode「Toutiao CEO apologizes for Neihan Duanzi after ordered removal from app stores」、36Kr「At 24, He Came to Beijing and Casually Invested in Zhang Yiming」、TechCrunch「Here's what you should know about the US TikTok deal」、South China Morning Post「ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming plays critical role in firm's AI push despite low profile」、Global Times「ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming's ascent to Asia's richest reflects China's AI monetization edge」、Forbes「AI Mania Makes ByteDance Cofounder Zhang Yiming China's Richest Person」、Herbert Simon (1971)「Designing Organizations for an Information-Rich World」、Watts, Duncan & Quan (2018) Psychological Science、Rochet & Tirole (2003) Journal of the European Economic Association
